a: JagX AI is a text+coding API backend built by JagX and JRILICENSE with permanent API keys.
POST https://jagx-ai-v2.onrender.com/chat with header x-api-key and JSON {"message":"..."}.
On Render free tier, ping /health regularly so the service does not sleep.
Uses cloud LLM providers (e.g. Groq/OpenRouter) plus local knowledge packs for speed.
knowledge_pack*.json files load at startup for instant answers on common topics.
JAGX_ADMIN_SECRET protects /create-key so only you can mint keys.
Put critical keys in JAGX_PERMANENT_KEYS so they survive disk resets.
Chat logs can append to jagx_training_data.jsonl when training logging is enabled.
Optional run_code field can execute short snippets via a sandbox API when configured.
Optional search field can fetch quick web snippets when enabled.
Responses are sanitized to present as JagX AI by JagX & JRILICENSE.
Lower temperature, good system prompt, valid Groq model, and more knowledge packs improve answers.
